title: Stirling Processor
description: Automate PDF work with sources, pipelines and policies, then track every run.
article:
Stirling Processor

Stirling Processor runs PDF workflows for you, in bulk or as new files arrive: source → steps → destination.

Not in the desktop app; see Setup and access.

Start here#

Follow Create your first pipeline to build, test and switch on a compression pipeline.

Find your way around#

Page Use it to
Sources Connect folders, storage services and webhooks.
Pipelines Build, test, pause and edit workflows.
Policies Set up ready-made pipelines: Ingestion, Security, Classification, Compliance and Routing.
Documents View recent processing activity and export it as CSV.
Review Investigate and resolve failed runs.
Integrations Save connections to external services.

Processing folders attach a workflow to a folder in your file library.
